risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company faces intense competition in the broker-dealer industry, which could lead to lower commissions and profit margins. (Part I, Item 1A)

risks.title: Technology Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on its proprietary technology, and any system failure or security breach could have severe consequences. (Part I, Item 1A)

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the broker-dealer industry, and any non-compliance could result in fines or penalties. (Part I, Item 1A)

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risk due to its lending and credit activities with clients. (Part I, Item 1A)

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces cybersecurity risks due to the nature of its operations, and any security incident could have serious consequences. (Part I, Item 1A)

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to geopolitical risks due to its international operations, and any geopolitical event could negatively impact its financial results. (Part I, Item 1A)
